original_test_intent: Verify the Type 7 Associativity enum for every cache record correctly describes the approved mapping organization—direct-mapped, N-way, fully associative, Other or Unknown—for that specific cache instance and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain the associativity byte per handle/level/designation, decode with the applicable SMBIOS enumeration, compare with the approved processor cache design and optional explicitly mapped OS evidence, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves per-cache associativity, applicable enum/Unknown policy, topology mapping and reboot plan. Enum collection and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Expected associativity for every Type 7 handle/level/cache instance
Applicable SMBIOS enum table, including supported non-power-of-two ways and Other/Unknown handling
Approved CPU/cache topology and Type 4 reference mapping
Optional documented mapping to an OS `ways_of_associativity` source
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS and optional topology sources only; do not flush/reconfigure caches, change CPU state or modify firmware.
Preserve the raw enum byte and cache identity; decoded labels can hide reserved/unknown values or wrong-record association.
Do not assume associativity must be a power of two or translate a newer enum with an older decoder table.
Use OS associativity only with a proven cache-instance mapping; OS cache indices can represent sharing/topology differently.
Stop on undefined enum, mapping ambiguity, unapproved drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw/decoded associativity per cache handle, apply version-aware enum mapping and compare approved cache topology before/after reboot.
Do not alter cache state, infer undocumented OS mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected associativity and handling of Other, Unknown, reserved or newer enum values.
Approve topology/reboot recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep loses raw enum, handle/level identity and decoder-version context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, extract associativity byte per handle and decode with the applicable SMBIOS table; add OS corroboration only with explicit cache mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Cache Associativity scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw associativity enum for every Type 7 handle using the correct SMBIOS revision, retain reserved/unknown values and compare with the approved cache-level design before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU/cache SKU/topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Associativity enumeration, approved processor/cache specification and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum provenance, version handling, cache identity and guarded cross-source mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; avoids wrong enum interpretation and cross-cache comparison errors.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-cache associativity map and enum policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS-exposed ways may describe a different cache slice or shared instance; firmware and OS records require explicit topology correlation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve any defined associativity enum, including documented non-power-of-two ways or Unknown, per cache handle; it must not normalize all levels to one generic value.
expected_evidence: Approved per-cache associativity map, SMBIOS enum/version, Unknown/Other policy and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 7 table with handle/level/designation, raw enum and decoded associativity
Type 4/topology association and any separately mapped OS corroboration
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict with disposition for any reserved/newer value

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly names a canonical Type 7 enum; expected associativity values are project inputs.
